note: ElevenLabs Creative flow holding the sandbox's sound generations (run through the ElevenLabs connector on 2026-10-29, about 1,200 credits in all). Each node's takes were downloaded into raw/ as <file>-<n>.mp3, numbered in the order listed; takes.json says which of them each sound is built from. Kept so takes can be re-picked or re-run on the canvas.

nodes.prompt: Explosive charge detonating against a concrete wall, sharp concussive crack into a deep heavy boom, debris burst, low rolling rumble tail

Building structure straining before collapse, deep groan of bending steel beams and grinding concrete

Large section of a concrete building collapsing, roar of tons of rubble crashing down, long heavy rumble settling
Huge concrete block slamming onto a concrete floor, deep heavy bass impact, single hit, short rubble scatter
Brick and concrete wall breaking apart, heavy chunks tumbling and crunching onto the ground
Steel girder bending under heavy load, loud metallic creak and groan, stressed metal straining
